name: Italian
notes: Eleven courses: two foundation, five core, four electives.
NOT auto-enforced: at least one elective should be in literature prior to the 16th century.
The page also lists Eastman (HUM 281-x) and other-department courses eligible as electives; only ITAL courses are modeled.

requirementGroups.label: Foundation courses (fulfil upper-level writing)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CORE COURSES (five): ITAL 151: Intermediate Italian I; ITAL 152: Intermediate Italian II; ITAL 200: Advanced Italian Composition and Conversation; ITAL 202: Introduction to Italian Culture in Italian; ITAL 203: Introduction to Italian Literature; ITAL 220: Dante's Divine Comedy Part I

requirementGroups.label: Italian electives (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ELECTIVE COURSES (four): Students can choose any four courses among the following. At least one of these should be in literature prior to the 16th century. ITAL 207; ITAL 221; ITAL 222; ITAL 229; ITAL 242; ITAL 243; ITAL 246; ITAL 247; ITAL 260
